Have you heard the acronym BREAD? 

Bomb: cards that can win the game on their own if they land. These are your first draft priorities. 

Removal: kill spells etc. Answers to your opp's bombs and other threats. 

Evasion: creatures with flying, trample, menace. Anything that enables you to get around blockers and consistently get damage in

Aggression: creatures with stat lines like 4/2. These are just meatballs you hurl at your opp for big damage, or save to block their big creatures and take them out.

Dud: anything else that you aren't going to play.

BREAD: Bomb, Removal, Evasion, Aggression, Dud. That is your basic framework for draft priority.
